## What does the parameter tell us? {#fv3-parameter .fv-lesson .line-lesson}

```{=html}
<div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{r}=\underset{\sim}{p}+\lambda(\underset{\sim}{q}-\underset{\sim}{p})=(1-\lambda)\underset{\sim}{p}+\lambda\underset{\sim}{q}"></span></div><div data-line-position></div><p class="line-segment-note">For the line segment <span data-math="PQ"></span>, restrict the parameter to <span data-math="0\leq\lambda\leq1"></span>.</p>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet §3.2 · p. 46</div>

::: {.notes}
Use the fixed spatial view to connect with the booklet diagram. P and Q stay fixed; R and its position vector change as λ changes. The relation PR=λPQ holds for every λ. Explore negative values, zero, an interior value, one and values greater than one. The interior ratio is PR:RQ=λ:(1−λ); at λ=1/2 R is the midpoint. Endpoint states explicitly show R=P and R=Q. The slider samples −0.75≤λ≤1.75, not the whole parameter domain. The equation describes the full line for λ in R. No camera rotation is needed.
:::
